text.card: A red giant 10,456 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.19 solar masses and 12.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,935 K at its surface.
